Richard has also placed rethinking on github. Unfortunately it lacks a NAMESPACE file, so it's not directly installable. I've cloned his repository and added the NAMESPACE now, so you should be able to install it with:

require(devtools) #install 'devtools` from CRAN if you don't have it
install_gitub("rethinking", "noamross")

messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Ack! Rethinking package installation not working. In urgent need...help!
parts:
Whoops! That should be install_github not install_gitub. Richard has actually merged the modifications in; you can now install directly from his github repository, which is probably a better default option since it's a lot less likely to be down than his personal website (which seems to be down at the moment), or my repository, which may not be up-do-date. So:

require(devtools)
install_github("rethinking", "rmcelreath")

Richard has also placed rethinking on github. Unfortunately it lacks a NAMESPACE file, so it's not directly installable. I've cloned his repository and added the NAMESPACE now, so you should be able to install it with:
